scripts.check: npm run check:state && npm run lint && npm test && npm run check:go && npm run check:web
scripts.check:go: cd apps/api-go && test -z "$(gofmt -l .)" && export GOPATH="$(cd ../.. && pwd)/.cache/go" && export GOCACHE="${GOCACHE:-$(cd ../.. && pwd)/.cache/go-build}" && go vet ./... && go test ./...
scripts.check:web: npm --prefix apps/web-vue run build && node scripts/copy-dist.mjs
scripts.api: cd apps/api-go && export GOPATH="$(cd ../.. && pwd)/.cache/go" && export GOCACHE="${GOCACHE:-$(cd ../.. && pwd)/.cache/go-build}" && go run .
